ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Waste food daily

2. Which response best shows understanding of Significance of Islamic Morality? (1 mark)
   A. Say Significance of Islamic Morality has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Significance of Islamic Morality.
   C. Apply the teaching of Significance of Islamic Morality with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Significance of Islamic Morality to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives.
   D. Say Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an.
   B. Say Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Virtues in Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Say Virtues in Islam has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Virtues in Islam.
   C. Use Virtues in Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Virtues in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

7. Which response best shows understanding of Prohibitions in Islam Zina? (1 mark)
   A. Use Prohibitions in Islam Zina to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prohibitions in Islam Zina.
   C. Apply the teaching of Prohibitions in Islam Zina with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Prohibitions in Islam Zina has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Shariah religion intellect life property dignity? (1 mark)
   A. Say Shariah religion intellect life property dignity has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Shariah religion intellect life property dignity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Shariah religion intellect life property dignity.
   D. Use Shariah religion intellect life property dignity to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Qadar? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Belief in Qadar with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Belief in Qadar has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Belief in Qadar to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Qadar.

10. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

11. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Domestic violence 06 6.2 Iddah 05 6.3 Child custody 04 6.4 Polygamy in Islam 06 ? (1 mark)
   A. Use Domestic violence 06 6.2 Iddah 05 6.3 Child custody 04 6.4 Polygamy in Islam 06  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Domestic violence 06 6.2 Iddah 05 6.3 Child custody 04 6.4 Polygamy in Islam 06  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Domestic violence 06 6.2 Iddah 05 6.3 Child custody 04 6.4 Polygamy in Islam 06 .
   D. Say Domestic violence 06 6.2 Iddah 05 6.3 Child custody 04 6.4 Polygamy in Islam 06  has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Tawbah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Significance of Islamic Morality and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Prohibitions in Islam Zina and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
